title: ArimaResult
description: (Auto-)arima fitting result. Wrap everything in ArimaResult for easier refactoring if we want to use model-specific iteration results.

arimaModelInfo.description: This message is repeated because there are multiple arima models fitted in auto-arima. For non-auto-arima model, its size is one.
